scope.summary: Add a Buck2-native Rust test wiring generator and use it for the first 20 libs/ target-parity remediation members.
explicit_non_claims: No production CI authority, branch protection setting, or external infrastructure is changed.
No generated JSON face is hand-edited; generated faces are materialized only by infra/ci/materialize-cloud-ci-generated-faces.sh in the separate settle step.
The generator is a local bridge tool for ADR-0540 target-parity remediation and has no merge authority.
The remaining libs/ rust_test debt is intentionally left for later batches.

facets.F1_correctness: The generator enumerates workspace members from oya-workspace-members-kernel, filters tracked libs/ members with Rust test code and no BUCK rust_test target, and renders rust_test stanzas from each existing rust_library shape.
facets.F2_tests: TDD RED/GREEN covered missing generator fixtures, BUCK files without deps assignment, integration-test dependency inheritance, and target-parity baseline shrink from 634 to 614.
facets.F3_maintainability: The implementation is isolated to one additive tool crate with a pure library surface, thin CLI, Buck2 targets, and no new dependency outside existing workspace crates.
facets.F4_compatibility: Existing library targets are not renamed; the tool appends rust_test stanzas while preserving existing BUCK content and target names.
facets.F5_security: Production Rust forbids unsafe code and does not use unwrap/expect/panic; the tool reads tracked repository files and writes only selected BUCK files in apply mode.
facets.F6_privacy: The change processes repository metadata and source text only; no tenant, user, credential, or personal data flow changes.
facets.F7_operability: Operators can run --list, --check, and --apply --limit N --root libs/ through the Buck2 binary target; --check exits 1 while candidates remain.
facets.F8_performance: Candidate discovery uses tracked-file sets and direct BUCK/source reads without invoking Cargo builds or external services.
facets.F9_compliance: The content change cites ADR-0540/FRIC-1781063357, records multispectrum evidence and an audit-chain row, and leaves generated faces to the approved materializer.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal git revert of the additive tool crate, batch BUCK stanzas, target-parity count update, Cargo.lock package row, and evidence row.
facets.F11_observability: Buck2 unit, build, batch, and target-parity evidence records exact pass counts; --check reports 140 remaining candidates after batch-1.
facets.F13_migration: Reduces live target-parity Rust test debt from 634 to 614 while creating a repeatable generator for future batches.
